lucas: Heads-up: Security policy change effective immediately for model registry signing. From now on all signing operations must use short-lived signing tokens (STS) or KMS sign-with-audit (max lifetime 1h). Long-lived service account keys used for SignBlob will be revoked after a 48h grace period. This affects Hosted, Dedicated (auto-sync), and Private customers that opted into auto-sync.

sam: Can you paste the rollout plan? We need to update runtime and SDKs.

lucas: Rollout summary:
- Day 0 (now): Enforce detector that flags SignBlob calls using long-lived keys and emit high-severity audit events.
- 0-48h: Alert-only for Dedicated clusters; hard-enforce (reject) on Hosted after 48h if no mitigation.
- 72h: Revoke any flagged long-lived keys that haven't been rotated.
- Ongoing: Require SDK to support token refresh and accept ephemeral signing headers.

irene: Legal: we'll need a customer notification template for Dedicated/Private customers explaining impacts and rollback options. I'll draft.

kevin: Ops note: quick detection query to find long-lived SignBlob usage:
```
gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName:\"SignBlob\" AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:*-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com AND NOT protoPayload.request.metadata.token_options.expirationTime<\"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z\""
```
Adjust time filter accordingly.

oncall-ops: Oncall will run detection now and tag any high-usage principals. If we see third-party CI or partner runners using old keys, we'll disable and escalate.

sre-bot: [NOTICE] policy-change: model-signing-ephemeral -> enforcement=warn (initial). Rule pushed to verifiers at 2026-03-24T14:03:12Z.

lucas: Required developer actions (short):
- Replace SignBlob long-lived keys with KMS-based sign or STS token flows. Docs: https://internal.redwood/devsec/signing-ephemeral
- Update SDKs: call GetSigningToken() or use workload-identity federation. DevEx: please bump minor SDK within 72h to warn on deprecated keys.

kevin: For Dedicated customers that cannot rotate within 48h, create an exception workflow: open PSC ticket with justification + planned rotation date. We'll allow single 72h extension.

cs: I'll prepare customer-facing FAQ for CS + AE. Also flag any customers with explicit WORM requirements; exceptions need legal sign-off.

irene: Legal note: preserve audit logs and provide transparency. If a customer requests artifact provenance preserved, we will coordinate to re-attest rather than destroy.

sam: Technical question: will the verifier accept signatures from both old and ephemeral tokens during transition?

lucas: Verifier behavior now: warn-only for 48h; we will accept old signatures but log. After 48h Hosted will reject. Dedicated will stay in warn-mode unless they opted-in to auto-enforce. Private installs: we will push advisory and provide scripts but won't revoke keys remotely.

oncall-ops: Detection run complete: 7 long-lived keys found across projects (prod and staging). Filing SEC-TASKS for rotation.

kevin: I'll roll an automated job to rotate mreg signing keys to KMS and create ephemeral wrappers for the model-registry service. ETA ~6h for staging, 24-48h for prod.

sre-bot: [TASK] SEC-TASKS-452 created to rotate long-lived keys for model-registry.

lucas: Communication cadence: 1) internal notice (this thread) 2) CS + Legal customer notice within 3h 3) enforcement timeline reminders at 24h and 6h before hard reject.

oncall-ops: If you are a service owner and need assistance, ping @oncall-ops with service name and pivot window. We'll help with token exchange or temporary federation.

kevin: DevEx / SDK owners: expect a minor SDK release request. We'll include a runtime feature flag to enable ephemeral signing.

lucas: Final: This is high priority. Failure to rotate long-lived keys may result in automatic revocation after the grace window. Post any blockers here. :rotating_light:

cs: Noted. I'll prioritize outreach to top 10 Dedicated customers and list migration steps.
